content.title: Happy Easter Messages: What To Write In An Easter Card
content.text: Religious Easter GreetingsIf you’re Christian, Easter is all about celebrating the hope and renewal that comes with Christ’s resurrection. Whether you’re looking for a Bible verse, a prayer or a simple Christian Easter card message, there are plenty of ways to share the spirit of the season. Check out the ideas below to help you spread the Lord’s love this Easter!Wishing you Christ’s many blessings throughout this joyful season.May the Lord lift up your heart, at Easter and always.May the miracle of Easter bring you perfect peace.Hope you always feel His love shining in your life.Praying that you feel Christ’s peace all year.God bless you at Easter and always.“Blessed are those who have not seen and have yet believed.” — John 20:29“He is not here; he has risen!” — Luke 24:6-7“Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.” (John 11:25)Rejoice in hope this Easter season!Browse religious Easter cards from American Greetings.Inspirational Easter MessagesSpring is the perfect time to share an Easter message of hope and positivity with those you care about. It’s about fresh starts, brighter days and celebrating the little joys in life. Below are some inspirational Easter messages that are sure to spread love and remind someone how special they are.It’s such a hopeful time of year, and I wish you every good thing at Easter and always.Wishing you the hope and beauty of springtime and the promise of brighter days.Knowing someone as special as you adds a little extra joy to Easter.Hope Easter brings you as many smiles as you bring to others.You deserve nothing but happiness to bloom all year!Happy Easter — hop till you drop!Wishing you fresh starts and happy hearts this Easter!May Easter bring quiet joy and new beginnings.Easter reminds us that even after the darkest moments, hope rises again. Wishing you comfort, joy and beautiful new beginnings.Hope rises. Spring begins. Happy Easter!Funny Easter SayingsEaster isn’t just a time for reflection — it’s also a chance to have a little fun! From egg puns to bunny jokes, there’s an endless basket of laughs to share. Whether you’re sending cards to kids, friends or any special some-bunny, these Happy Easter messages are made for smiles.Hope you have an eggs-tra special Easter!You make my heart hoppy!Easter: the only time it’s okay to put all your eggs into one basket.You’re eggs-traordinary! Wishing you a Happy Easter!Easter is the only time it’s acceptable to eat chocolate for breakfast … enjoy!May your Easter be filled with all the candy, bunnies and all the happiness you can handle!Wishing my favorite egghead a happy Easter!You’re one cool chick… no eggs-aggeration!Ears to you this Easter!Browse funny Easter cards from American Greetings.Cute Easter GreetingsEaster means spreading love, joy and a little bit of cuteness! Whether you’re sending sweet wishes to a friend, family member or that special someone, these cute Happy Easter wishes will make them smile from ear to ear. Here are some adorable ideas to share the love this Easter:I’m just hopping by to wish you a Happy Easter!Sending you bunny kisses and Easter wishes!You brighten my day like no-bunny else!Happy Easter to my honey bunny!Hopping into your day with lots of love and Easter cheer!Wishing you an Easter as sweet as you are.You’re eggs-tra special to me this Easter!Sending you basketfuls of love and joy this Easter!Happy Easter to one of my favorite Peeps!Some bunny thinks you’re really great. Happy Easter!Just chick-ing in to wish you a happy Easter!No yolk — life’s better with you in my basket!Browse cute Easter cards from American Greetings.Messages for Springtime JoyFor many people, Easter marks the official start of spring. The return of the sun and warmer days melt away our last bits of cabin fever as the earth wakes up from its long winter nap. You can’t help but feel hopeful as springtime flowers pop up everywhere and the daylight lingers longer, so it’s the perfect time to share messages welcoming the new season with the people we love.It’s such a hopeful and happy season for remembering special people like you.Thinking of you and wishing you all the nicest things this season.Always remember — you’re somebunny special!Sending you ‘eggstra’ love today and always.Happy Spring — to one of my favorite peeps!Wishing you a bright and happy spring!Personalize Cards With Your Own Happy Easter Holiday GreetingsNo matter how you celebrate, sending happy Easter messages — whether funny, cute, inspirational or religious — are the perfect way to connect with those who matter most this spring.
